subject: Final readiness checkpoint — commitment ceremony logistics & start-slot
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@stellarretail.com>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@stellarretail.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commitment ceremony proposal + SOW v3

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for walking us through the MAP and the evaluation outcomes this week. Per our procurement cadence, we want to lock the final paperwork and a start-slot so internal schedule and vendors can be lined up. Attached: SOW v3 (edits from our side) and a spreadsheet with signature window options.

Ask: can you confirm the internal approvers (who will sign) and the earliest available start date if we complete signatures by end of next week? Our preferred on-ramp is the week of July 5th but we can flex.

We are aiming for a go/no-go decision by EOD 30 June so our board can include the buy in the July procurement batch. If there are any remaining redlines, please flag them now.

Attachments: Stellar_Retail_SOW_v3.pdf, Signature_Window_Options.xlsx

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships
Stellar Retail

-----
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@stellarretail.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment ceremony proposal + SOW v3

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the attached SOW. Quick summary from our side so everyone has the same visibility:

- Internal approvers we need looped for signature: Monica (product/commercial acceptance), Karthik (legal), Laura (finance).
- Preferred start: we can realistically support a July 7th start if signatures are completed by July 2nd; otherwise July 12th is our next open slot.
- Doc routing: we prefer DocuSign for signatures; if Stellar requires countersignature blocks, please indicate the signer names and titles.

I attached a short checklist (Mutual_Action_Plan_URL.txt) that maps out the final items we need cleared before the ink ceremony: final SOW, approved billing contact, KMS key exchange for logs, and kickoff resource list.

We’ll aim to provide a final internal go/no-go by EOD 30 June. Karthik — can you confirm whether the redlines in SOW v3 are material or a clean accept? Laura — any billing or POs to raise before signature?

Thanks — I’ll consolidate replies and send a single DocuSign envelope with the signature window options.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment ceremony proposal + SOW v3 — legal check

Quick legal read after reviewing SOW v3 and the redlines Samantha included. Short version: mostly non-substantive edits; one clause in section 6.2 re: data retention needs tighter wording to match our standard. I can push a single-sentence amendment that preserves Stellar's ask while keeping our liability profile intact.

Proposed path:
- I will prepare a one-paragraph addendum and circulate for approval by EOD 26 June.
- Suggest we use DocuSign with two signature blocks (Stellar PO sig + Redwood authorized signatory).
- If anything else shows up on 26/27 June, we should treat July 2nd as the target sign-by date to keep the July 7th start. If redlines expand, reserve July 12th as contingency.

Logan — please confirm who the authorized Redwood signatory will be on the DocuSign envelope (I can pre-fill).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Team / Samantha —

All internal approvals are in. Karthik’s addendum is acceptable, Laura confirmed billing and PO path, and I signed off on the commercial acceptance criteria. Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope — Logan, please include the two-slot options from the attachment but prioritize the July 7th start.

Signed SOW (final): Stellar_Retail_SOW_FINAL_signed.pdf (to be uploaded to the drive once DocuSign completes).

Start date confirmed: July 8, 2027 (internal ramp day July 7 for admin and VM provisioning).

Next steps for Samantha/Evan: please confirm the billing contact and the onboarding invite window. Logan will send the kickoff calendar and the onboarding resource list.

Thanks — committing to the run.
